description: Antennes de la Région Hauts-de-France is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Hauts-de-France. Location and coordinates of the proximity antennas of the Hauts-de-France Regional Council as of 1 January 2025. Coverage: Région Hauts-de-France. The portal shows the English title as "Category: Antennae of the Hauts-de-France Region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région Hauts-de-France. Its keywords include hauts-de-france, somme-departement, somme, antenne, region32, administration. The listing shows 6 download or service links in 0-HTTP--LINK. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
